header.headline: Start the clinical conversation
header.subhead: Form labels are already defined in the application; this page provides the introduction around them. Choose the track that matches your intent so the right team replies.

intro: KONSENXIA conversations start with your setting: specialty mix, IT landscape, and the compliance questions you must answer before any pilot. Give us that context and we will route it to the right people.

tracks.title: Demo
tracks.body: A walkthrough of the consultation surface, doctor-to-doctor flow, and anonymization design — with architecture and legal docs on screen.

tracks.title: Pilot
tracks.body: A scoped evaluation with your clinical informatics team: workflow fit, data boundary, and success criteria agreed before anything runs.

tracks.title: Investor
tracks.body: Narrative, architecture, and the metrics registry — including what is architecture, what is roadmap, and what does not exist yet.

tracks.title: Partner / Press
tracks.body: Commercial agreements, integrations, channel partnerships, and press requests.

expectations: We reply from a named human, typically within two business days.
Clinical and compliance questions are answered with references to docs/legal/* and architecture records.
We will not describe roadmap items as shipped, or design goals as certifications.
formNote: Form fields (name, email, organisation, track, message) are implemented in the application. Do not duplicate field definitions here.
privacyNote: Do not include patient data or identifiable case details in the form. Contact data is handled under /privacy (KVKK / GDPR posture).
